title: A Survey of Machine Learning Models and Datasets for the Multi-label Classification of Textual Hate Speech in English
reasoning: The paper provides a comprehensive survey and comparative analysis of datasets and models used to classify hate speech, which includes evaluating and benchmarking categories related to religion, spiritual beliefs, and ethics. Multiple analyzed datasets (e.g., ETHOS, CONAN, Gab Hate Corpus) explicitly include 'Religion' or 'Islamophobia' as target labels for classification performance.
